title: Completed local coefficient algebra and its canonical scheme map
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a field [def-weil-field], let $T$ be a scheme over $\operatorname{Spec}\Omega$ [def-pc-scheme], [def-weil-affine-spectrum], and let $t\in T$. Give the actual completed local ring $\widehat{\mathcal O}_{T,t}$ [def-sfb-nodal-geometric-fibre-local-rings], [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion] its $\Omega$-algebra structure via the structural morphism and the stalk map. Define its canonical spectrum map to $T$ as $\operatorname{Spec}\widehat{\mathcal O}_{T,t}\to\operatorname{Spec}\mathcal O_{T,t}\to T$, using the completion map. For a local $\Omega$-algebra $R$ and a specified residue $\Omega$-algebra isomorphism $\rho:\kappa(R)\simeq\Omega$, define its closed $\Omega$-point to be the spectrum of $R\to\kappa(R)\xrightarrow{\rho}\Omega$. The affine $\Omega$-scheme convention is [def-sfb-affine-action-quotient-stack].
